title: Walking Fingerprinting Using Wrist Accelerometry During Activities of Daily Living in NHANES
reason: Highly relevant direct wrist/identity preprint; final publication was not verified in this pass.
evidence_boundary: Top-1% candidate retrieval is not rank-1 identity accuracy. This work is not causal-intervention evidence.

title: EvoMorph: Counterfactual Explanations for Continuous Time-Series Extrinsic Regression Applied to Photoplethysmography
reason: Direct PPG counterfactual-explanation candidate; kept separate pending publication-status and full-method review.
evidence_boundary: Morphologically plausible PPG edits alter model inputs; they do not establish feasible actions on a person or a treatment effect.

title: MetaPlate: Counterfactual-Guided RAG-LLM Tool for Personalized Food Recommendation and Hyperglycemia Prevention
reason: Wearable/CGM and food-recommendation preprint; not promoted to validated intervention evidence.
evidence_boundary: Model what-if predictions and expert ratings are distinct from demonstrated glycemic improvement under assigned dietary interventions.

title: A Diffusion-Model Subpopulation Digital Twin for Mobile Health Deployment: A Case Study on the HeartSteps Intervention
reason: Formal archival publication not verified in this pass; excluded from accepted resource and paper counts.
summary: Conditional diffusion-based subpopulation simulator for HeartSteps deployment and policy exploration.
claim_boundary: Subpopulation simulation is not an individual twin, and temporal consistency alone does not establish causal identification or clinical policy benefit.
